identity.description_short: Fine-tuned transformer model for zero-shot metric depth estimation on outdoor scenes using synthetic Virtual KITTI data.

description: This model is a fine-tuned version of Depth Anything V2 specialized for outdoor metric depth estimation, leveraging the DPT architecture with a DINOv2 backbone. It processes input images to produce absolute depth maps, achieving state-of-the-art results on synthetic and real unlabeled datasets. The specific entry targets the 'Depth-Anything-V2-Metric-Outdoor-Small-hf' variant (24.8M parameters), which requires the transformers library for operation.
name: Depth-Anything-V2-Metric-Outdoor-Small-hf
